committee.sub: Morning brief · Saturday 3 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend climbed to $135.01 from $117.46 over the last 7 days while conversions stayed at zero and CPC sits at $6.14. Post restart clicks are now at 84 of the 150 stop loss threshold.
Budget lost share (23.3%) remains well under rank lost share (71.8%), so the budget conversation stays closed. CTR fell from 5% to 2.8% even as impressions nearly doubled to 797.

Calculator use dropped to 0 last7 from 1 prior7 and form starts are flat at 0. Landing traffic is concentrated on the homepage (34 sessions) and /ai-automation-agency.html (17), with little depth elsewhere.

AI Assistant sessions held at 1 for a second week, with chatgpt.com the named source, though this undercounts clicks that land in Direct with no referrer. Organic Search fell to 3 sessions from 12, and LinkedIn sits at zero despite Chris continuing to post there, which points to untagged links rather than no activity.

actions.text: Logo and image assets plus keyword-matched RSA headlines for the currently serving ad groups are still outstanding.
The homepage form confirm-then-count fix is still open: kontrolTrackLead should fire on the Formspree verdict, not before it.
RSA description D1 still claims 13.3 hours of admin per week and needs updating to match the current site stats.
